spec.claim_summary: Long BTC on 4-hour Supertrend flip to uptrend with ATR stop, partial take-profit at 0.75R with breakeven move and exit of remainder on flip to downtrend.
assumptions: BTCUSD mapped to Binance spot symbol BTCUSDT.
Supertrend settings not stated; used TradingView defaults ATR length 10 and multiplier 3; exit uses same settings.
ATR stop-loss length and multiplier not stated; used 2 x ATR(14) taken at signal bar.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: partial exit - claim closes only half position at 0.75 risk/reward and holds remainder to opposite Supertrend flip; engine holds one full position, so spec models the runner half held to opposite flip with no 0.75R full-position exit to avoid cutting off runner upside.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: moving stop loss to breakeven after TP1 for the runner; spec keeps fixed ATR stop with no breakeven move.
Backtest period recorded in claimed, not as rule; engine tests over all history starting flat.

evidence.quote: you enter into a long position.
Once Supertrend changes from a downtrend to a uptrend, you enter into a long position.
Once Supertrend changes from a uptrend to a downtrend, you close the other half of the initial long position.

audit_majors: take_profit_r: Claim requires closing half position at 0.75 risk/reward; spec sets take_profit_r null and holds full position to opposite Supertrend flip, omitting TP1 leg.
stop_atr_mult: Claim requires moving stop loss to break even after TP1; spec keeps fixed 2.0x ATR(14) stop with no breakeven move.
